# ContextMenu

Header: `winui/ui/menus/ContextMenu.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/menus/ContextMenu.hpp`.

A child with a context menu. Built by [ui::ContextMenu](#uicontextmenu).

A right-click anywhere on the child, or Shift+F10 or the Menu key while focus is inside it, opens the items as a menu: at the pointer, or for the keyboard over the focused element. A context menu nested deeper wins over this one, and an [on_context_requested()](../tree/element.md#on_context_requested) handler on an element inside it runs first. With no items it opens nothing.

Example: 
```cpp
auto  host  = std::make_unique<ui::ContextMenuControl>();
auto* label = host->set_child(std::make_unique<ui::TextControl>("Order 1042"));
host->set_items({
    {.text = "Copy", .on_click = [label] { ui::clipboard().set_text(label->text()); }},
    {.text = "Save as...", .on_click = [] { save(); }},
});
```

## `ui::ContextMenu`

A context menu around any piece of UI. Builds a [ui::ContextMenuControl](#uicontextmenucontrol).

A right-click on [`.content`](#uicontextmenu-content), or Shift+F10 or the Menu key while focus is inside it, opens [`.items`](#uicontextmenu-items) as a menu at the pointer, or over the focused element for the keyboard. The content does not need to be focusable: a right-click on a [Text](text.md#uitext) or an [Image](image.md#uiimage) opens it too. For one menu per row of a list use the view's `.item_context_menu` instead.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<std::string> note{"Buy milk"};
window.set_content(ui::ContextMenu{
    .items =
        {
            {.text = "Copy", .icon = ui::Symbol::Copy, .on_click = [&] { ui::clipboard().set_text(note.get()); }},
            ui::MenuItem::separator(),
            {.text = "Delete", .icon = ui::Symbol::Delete, .on_click = [&] { note = ""; }},
        },
    .content = ui::Text{.text = note},
});
```

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::ContextMenu{
    .items, .style, .margin, .width, .height, .min_width, .min_height, .max_width, .max_height,
    .horizontal_alignment, .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip, .accessibility,
    .on_pointer_entered, .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus, .on_key_down,
    .on_wheel, .control, .content
}
```

Fields, in declaration order (designators must follow it):

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <span id="uicontextmenu-items"></span>`items` | `ui::Binding<std::vector<ui::MenuItem>>` |  | The menu's entries: items, toggles, radio items, separators and submenus. |
| <span id="uicontextmenu-on_pointer_entered"></span>`on_pointer_entered` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer moved onto the control. |
| <span id="uicontextmenu-on_pointer_exited"></span>`on_pointer_exited` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer left the control. |
| <span id="uicontextmenu-on_got_focus"></span>`on_got_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus arrived on the control, or on anything inside it, from outside it. A control with nothing focusable in it never gets focus, and never raises this. |
| <span id="uicontextmenu-on_lost_focus"></span>`on_lost_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus left the control and everything inside it. |
| <span id="uicontextmenu-on_key_down"></span>`on_key_down` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::KeyEvent&)>` |  | A key pressed while focus is on the control or inside it, before the control's own handling; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_key_down()](../tree/element.md#on_key_down)). |
| <span id="uicontextmenu-on_wheel"></span>`on_wheel` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::PointerEvent&)>` |  | A wheel turn over the control, before the control scrolls; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_wheel()](../tree/element.md#on_wheel)). |
| <span id="uicontextmenu-control"></span>`control` | `ui::ControlOut<ui::ContextMenu>` |  | Out: the handle that receives the built control. |
| <span id="uicontextmenu-content"></span>`content` | `ui::Spec` |  | What the menu belongs to. |

Plus the common fields `style`, `margin`, `width`, `height`, `min_width`, `min_height`, `max_width`, `max_height`, `horizontal_alignment`, `vertical_alignment`, `visible`, `tool_tip`, `accessibility` every spec carries ([conventions](../conventions.md#common-fields-on-every-spec)).


Consumes the spec and returns the built [ui::ContextMenuControl](#uicontextmenucontrol); the caller owns it.

## `ui::ContextMenuControl`

Derives from `ui::ContentHost`.

A child with a context menu. Built by [ui::ContextMenu](#uicontextmenu).

A right-click anywhere on the child, or Shift+F10 or the Menu key while focus is inside it, opens the items as a menu: at the pointer, or for the keyboard over the focused element. A context menu nested deeper wins over this one, and an [on_context_requested()](../tree/element.md#on_context_requested) handler on an element inside it runs first. With no items it opens nothing.

Example: 
```cpp

auto* label = host->set_child(std::make_unique<ui::TextControl>("Order 1042"));
host->set_items({
    {.text = "Copy", .on_click = [label] { ui::clipboard().set_text(label->text()); }},
```
